{"fragment": true, "screens": [{"tag": "screen", "attrs": {"name": "screenpart_ChoiceBoxBody", "size": "1920,1080"}, "children": [{"tag": "widget", "attrs": {"backgroundColor": "md_surface", "font": "md_title_medium_emphasized", "foregroundColor": "md_secondary", "name": "text", "position": "10,10", "size": "1900,0", "valign": "center"}, "children": null, "text": null}, {"tag": "widget", "attrs": {"backgroundColor": "md_surface", "font": "md_body_medium", "foregroundColor": "md_primary", "name": "description", "position": "10,1080", "size": "1900,0", "transparent": "1"}, "children": null, "text": null}, {"tag": "widget", "attrs": {"backgroundColor": "md_surface", "enableWrapAround": "1", "itemCornerRadius": "12", "itemHeight": "45", "name": "list", "position": "0,0", "size": "1920,1080", "transparent": "1", "zPosition": "2"}, "children": null, "text": null}, {"tag": "applet", "attrs": {"type": "onLayoutFinish"}, "children": null, "text": "from enigma import ePoint
# the body: where the list was put, and the size it was given (all of the body)
bodyX = self["list"].instance.position().x()
bodyY = self["list"].instance.position().y()
bodyWidth = self["list"].instance.size().width()
bodyHeight = self["list"].instance.size().height()
margin = 10
# the text above the list: as high as its text needs at the width of the body (none if the box has no text)
textHeight = 0
textpos = self["text"].instance.position()
if not (textpos.x() < 0 and textpos.y() < 0):
 self["text"].resize(bodyWidth - 2 * margin, self["text"].getSize()[1])
 textHeight = self["text"].getSize()[1]
 self["text"].resize(bodyWidth - 2 * margin, textHeight)
top = bodyY
if textHeight > 0:
 self["text"].move(bodyX + margin, bodyY + margin)
 top = bodyY + margin + textHeight + margin
# the description of the selected entry, at the bottom of the body, if any entry has one
descriptionHeight = 0
if bool(self.list) and any([(True if len(x[0]) > 2 and x[0][2] and isinstance(x[0][2], str) else False) for x in self.list]):
 descriptionHeight = 75
bottom = bodyY + bodyHeight
if descriptionHeight > 0:
 bottom -= descriptionHeight + margin
 self["description"].move(bodyX + margin, bottom + margin)
 self["description"].resize(bodyWidth - 2 * margin, descriptionHeight)
# the list: whole rows between the text and the description
itemHeight = self["list"].l.getItemSize().height()
rows = max(1, (bottom - top) // itemHeight)
self["list"].move(bodyX, top)
self["list"].resize(bodyWidth, rows * itemHeight)"}], "text": null}]}
